hypotheses.statement: The release changed checkout pod labels so they no longer match the Service selector (app=checkout, track=canary), resulting in zero endpoints and 503s.
The release introduced an application-level failure in checkout pods (e.g., startup/readiness failure or crash loop), so pods matching the Service selector exist but are not ready.
